scenario: Compiler emits one analysis report per compilation per LCMP.1.1. Any successful compilation exercises this — the report is always produced. Pin: a minimal valid DS source compiles cleanly, demonstrating the pipeline runs to completion and would emit one report.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Int mutable

rule handle:

->
